title: Why every Wikimedian should be a toolmaker
summary: The article argues that every Wikimedian should engage in toolmaking, emphasizing the importance of creating and maintaining tools to improve the Wikimedia ecosystem, and highlights the benefits of toolmaking for both individuals and the community.
highlights: Every Wikimedian has the potential to be a toolmaker, regardless of technical background.
Toolmaking fosters a culture of innovation and self-sufficiency within the Wikimedia community.
Simple tools can have a significant impact on the efficiency and quality of Wikimedia projects.
